1A G 30464— 27 (07/ 2019)

TOURISM ACT, No. 38 OF 2005

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by the Section 70 of the Tourism Act, No. 38 of 2005, I, John Antony EmmanualAmarathunga, Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs, do hereby order in line with theSection 49(a) of the Land Acquisitions Act, that the land mentioned in the Schedule below is required to be acquired for thepurpose of development of tourism by Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority.

JOHN ANTONY EMMANUAL AMARATHUNGA,Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife andChristian Religious Affairs.Colombo,27th June 2019.

Schedule

The land 199.6 hectare approximately (493 Acre) in extent depicted by Geodetic coordinate and plan given below prepared byDivisional Secretary (Hikkaduwa) situated in the villages of Akurala, Galdoowa, Dimbuladoowa, Uduwaragoda, Kahawa,Weragoda in the Grama Niladhari Divisions Akurala, Galdoowa, Dimbuladoowa, Uduwaragoda North, Kahawa, Weragodain Hikkaduwa, Divisional Secretary’s Division in Galle District of Southern Province.

North:Northern boundaries of Grama Niladhari Divisions of Dimbuldoowa, Galdoowa and Weragoda.East:Eastern boundaries of Grama Niladhari Divisions of Dimbuldoowa, Galdoowa and Weragoda.South:Southern boundaries of Weragoda, Kahawa, Uduwaragoda North and Akurala ;West:Western boundaries of Kahawa, Uduwaragoda North, Akurala and Dimbuldoowa
